name: data mount hides the folders the image makes
why: AidenHQ#216/#217 (reliability checklist data-mount-dirs): the scanner's /cache became a bind-mounted module data folder; the folders its Dockerfile made under it were hidden, /cache/tmp was missing, every grype db update failed and no scan pass completed for a day. In scope and harmless to security, so only the checklist item catches it.

card.sentence: Open a PR: keep the scanner's grype database and temp files in its module data folder
card.reason: pr to the product repo by platform-engineer

diff:
diff --git a/modules/security/module.yaml b/modules/security/module.yaml
index 3c4d5e6..7f8a9b0 100644
--- a/modules/security/module.yaml
+++ b/modules/security/module.yaml
@@ -98,13 +98,16 @@ services:
     security-scanner:
       build: ./scanner
-      tmp: 1g
+      tmp: 64m
       egress: true # grype's vulnerability database, App Auditor
       links: [paperclip, sources] # Paperclip's webhook; the warehouse (shared sources)
       data:
         - sbom:/sbom:ro # written by the host timer
+        - cache:/cache
         - registry:/registry:ro # the instance's apps.yaml, copied by scripts/compile.mjs on every compile
       env:
         WAREHOUSE_PASSWORD_FILE: ${secrets.warehouse_src_security_password}
         SBOM_DIR: /sbom
+        GRYPE_DB_CACHE_DIR: /cache/grype-db
+        TMPDIR: /cache/tmp
         # The Security Watch routine's signed webhook (read at fire time; setup writes the files).
         SCAN_WEBHOOK_URL_FILE: ${secrets.security_scan_webhook_url}
diff --git a/modules/security/scanner/Dockerfile b/modules/security/scanner/Dockerfile
index 1a2b3c4..5d6e7f8 100644
--- a/modules/security/scanner/Dockerfile
+++ b/modules/security/scanner/Dockerfile
@@ -18,5 +18,7 @@ WORKDIR /app
 COPY --from=build /app/node_modules ./node_modules
 COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
 COPY package.json ./
+# /cache: grype's database and its temp files, kept across restarts instead of in tmpfs.
+RUN mkdir -p /cache/grype-db /cache/tmp && chown -R 1000:100 /cache
 USER 1000:1000
 CMD ["node", "dist/src/main.js"]
chain: Owner: the security scanner downloads grype's vulnerability database again after every restart, and its temp files fill the 1 GB tmpfs. Give it a persistent cache in its module data folder (mounted at /cache) for the database and its temp files, and shrink the tmpfs.
claim: Moves the grype cache to the scanner's data folder; the Dockerfile creates the folders.
